generator: tools/fx/gen_ui5.py (procedural numpy + Pillow on fxlib; house style of ui / ui2 / ui3 / ui4)

conventions.contract: CONTRACT_V42 §AL. Paths relative to frost-village/assets/. Fragment name: ui5 (the build packs it with chief_fx into the v42_core page).
conventions.text: No text is baked; the game renders every label.
conventions.style: House soft-toy style (fxlib.toy): dark tinted outline, bevel lit from the upper left, gloss, one navy drop shadow. Icons read at 32 px on cream and on dark.
conventions.nineSlice: Panel frames live in the atlas UNTRIMMED, so Phaser NineSlice can use them directly: this.add.nineslice(x, y, 'ui5_icons', 'ui_letter', w, h, left, right, top, bottom) with the margins of nineSlice[key]. contentInset = [left, top, right, bottom] px from the stretched edges where the game lays out content.

pagePlan.why: polish (critic M4): the panels are ~0.9 MiB of this page and only the office panel uses them. When the build packs v42_core (chief_fx + ui5), keep the icons + status dots resident and put the panel frames on the transient office-panel page (plan §13.2 "panel page 1.6 MiB").

conventions.renamedWhy: ui_icon_play is already a pets2 sprite (the dog play-fetch ball used by src/scenes/UI.js); a second ui_icon_play would replace it at merge (Object.assign) or be dropped (mergeLate). The settings-tab 놀이 icon is ui_icon_play_tab.

ui_icon_binoculars.notes: 관망 모드 (observe-mode button, 56 round): chunky teal binoculars, a sparkle in one lens.

ui_icon_hand.notes: 줍기 button / 자동 줍기 setting: the chief's open white mitten with a gold sparkle above the palm.

ui_icon_route.notes: 길 안내 setting / nav chip: dotted footprints curving to a teal map pin.

ui_icon_office.notes: 촌장 사무실 / 업무 chip: cream office, teal roof, gable clock, a window lit by a desk lamp.

ui_icon_letter.notes: 편지 (letters tab / new letter): cream envelope with a red heart wax seal.

ui_icon_inventory.notes: 재고 tab / 재고판: clipboard with four coloured stock bars (red, orange, blue, green).

ui_icon_news.notes: 소식 tab (서리 소식): the village paper folded in half, snowflake emblem on a blue masthead (ui4 ui_icon_newspaper is the town's pinecone paper).

ui_icon_bank.notes: 서리 은행: small civic building (columns, steps, pediment) under a gold coin dome.

ui_icon_staff.notes: 직원 tab: two friendly heads, one in a suit with a tie, one with a pink bow.

ui_icon_halo.notes: 촌장 후광 setting / new-features card: a little chief standing on an aurora ring.

ui_icon_cheer.notes: 촌장 응원: a raised white mitten with two music notes.

ui_icon_depot.notes: 물류창고: blue warehouse with an orange crate in its open door.

ui_icon_sleigh.notes: 화물 썰매: a pony head pulling a little sleigh with a crate.

ui_icon_coach.notes: 열차 카드 객차: sky-blue coach, teal roof, warm lit windows, on a rail.

ui_icon_boxcar.notes: 열차 카드 화물칸: chestnut box car with an X-brace sliding door, on a rail.

ui_icon_flatcar.notes: 열차 카드 무개화차: flat car carrying three crates, on a rail.

ui_icon_play_tab.notes: settings tab 놀이: a snowflake over a small joystick knob. CONTRACT_V42 calls it ui_icon_play, but pets2 already owns ui_icon_play (the dog's play-fetch ball in src/scenes/UI.js), so use this key.

ui_icon_new.notes: "새로워진 것" card: a red gift box with a gold ribbon and a sparkle.

ui_letter.notes: 편지 page (OfficePanel letters, 720 x 1100 logical): cream letter paper, faint blue ruled lines, a pinecone stamp in the top-right corner, the envelope flap with its shadow across the top. Write the sender in the flap band (y 8-36), the letter text inside contentInset. The ruling lives in the stretched centre: at the source height its lines are ruling.firstLineY + n x ruling.lineGap; on a panel of height h they sit at top + (y - top) x (h - top - bottom) / (400 - top - bottom) - set the text line height to lineGap x that factor to write on the lines, or draw your own lines.

ui_chalk_panel.notes: 재고 tab background: dark green chalkboard in a wooden frame with a chalk tray (chalk and eraser in the bottom corners). Light text / status dots read on it.

ui_office_tab.notes: Office panel tab (inactive): cream with a teal rim, open at the bottom - put it on the panel's top edge (bottom edge of the tab = panel edge).

ui_office_tab_on.notes: Office panel tab (active): raised 6 px, brighter, teal cap and a stronger shadow; same frame and margins as ui_office_tab so they swap in place.

ui_chip.notes: HUD chips (navigation chip 240 x 44 CSS, 업무 chip, 관망 caption): rounded cream pill with a teal rim. Its round ends ARE the 32 px top / bottom slices: build the nineslice at 64 px tall and stretch only the width; for a smaller chip (CODE-1 chips are 50-56 logical) scale the whole object uniformly (setScale(h / 64), width w / that scale). Below 64 px tall the ends turn lemon-shaped (minHeight).

ui_status.notes: Glossy status dots for the 재고 board rows: ui_status_0 red 부족, ui_status_1 orange 길 막힘, ui_status_2 blue 남음, ui_status_3 green 적당.
